GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_VALID_CONFIG.desc: GRIBI table with every field set.

GRIBI_TABLE_WITHOUT_CERTS.desc: GRIBI table with no certs, served without TLS.

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_SERVER_CERT_ONLY.desc: GRIBI table with a key pair and no CA (server-only TLS).

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_INVALID_PORT.desc: GRIBI port 0 is out of range.

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_INVALID_FIB_ACK_TIMEOUT.desc: GRIBI fib_ack_timeout above 3600 is out of range.

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_INVALID_LOG_LEVEL.desc: GRIBI log_level must be one of the enumerated levels.

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_INVALID_REFLECTION.desc: GRIBI enable_reflection must be a boolean.

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_RELATIVE_CERT_PATH.desc: GRIBI certificate paths must be absolute.

eStr: server_crt and server_key must be configured together

GRIBI_TABLE_WITH_CA_BUT_NO_SERVER_CERT.desc: GRIBI ca_crt without a server key pair.
